purpose: Synchronize the validated Core attestation-authority lineage tip into Foundation through a signed GitHub OIDC control-plane path.
rules: The publisher validates canonical authority lineage before requesting an OIDC token.
Foundation accepts only GitHub-hosted OIDC from the immutable Core repository identity, main branch and dedicated authority-state workflow.
Every non-bootstrap activation names the currently active authority SHA as predecessor.
Forward promotion may introduce only a previously unused authority SHA.
Rollback may restore only a previously recorded authority SHA at the exact original workflow blob and referenced source sequence.
Exact request replay is idempotent; conflicting replay is rejected by the GitHub OIDC operation binding.
The database history is append-only and the current authority is derived only from that history.
